title: Sell or trade in the phone
ask: Write a short note on whether I should sell my phone privately or trade it in. For the trade-in side use the shop's figure for my model in buyback.md; private sales of the same model are going for about $360.
background: I'm hoping the trade-in is $310, because for a $50 gap I'd rather skip the hassle of selling.
It is a Model A2 with 128GB in good condition.
